name: Pattern Tracker Modules
author: Freek van Gool
description: Row-based song modules for Pattern Tracker: full-band patterns with a play order, repeats and the effect column (arpeggio, retrigger, delay, probability, gate, CC sweeps). Tracks: 1 kick, 2 snare/clap, 3 hats, 4 bass, 5 chords or arp, 6 lead, 7 pad, 8 percussion or a CC track named Filter/Cutoff. Connect tracks 1, 2, 3 and 8 to a drum machine (GM-style notes) and the others to synths. Folders: module classics, songwriting forms, world and Latin, electronic rows.
